text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- About 130,000 employees will be put out of work in 1997 and 1998, 70,000 of them will get unemployment benefit.
- The authorities invite political parties to take part in talks over an independent committee to supervise parliamentary elections planned for the first half of this year.
- Dozens of "terrorists" killed in security forces' operations in Chrea and Medea.
- More than 250 firms to be privatised soon.
